_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-05 04:16Z full cycle: scanned 454 candidates (--hours 168, discovery.py 3 queries, no fallback). Esports (LCK Hanwha/Gen.G, HANJIN BRION/Nongshim, LPL JDG/LGD, Dota 1win/BetBoom): every WebSearch 'odds' hit was either Polymarket's own market echoed back (¢/x-multiplier numbers matching PM prices exactly, titled '... Odds & Predictions | Polymarket') or a stale/wrong-date match -- no independent sportsbook number found for any August 5 fixture; new trap documented in playbook (esports search results are circular, not book-devig material). Soccer: SK Brann/Apollon Limassol showed two directly contradictory quoted lines (implied Brann-win ~54% vs ~65%, PM sitting between at 58.5%) -- mixed-line rule, skipped. Aarhus/Sabah produced an internally self-contradictory snippet (42.6% paired with 1.47 odds, which imply 68%) -- treated as no clean benchmark, skipped. Panathinaikos/CSKA 1948 and Villarreal C/Levante not pursued past the coverage check (thin/obscure coverage). MLB (Nationals/Phillies, Pirates/Brewers): covers.com, 975thefanatic.com, wincomparator.com, ratingbet.com, telecomasia.net all 403'd on WebFetch (consistent known pattern); WebSearch snippets gave rounded/inconsistent totals ('total is 9' vs our 9.5 line) not tied to a quoted sportsbook figure -- coverage precondition not met, skipped. Earnings: OXY (non-GAAP EPS threshold $1.88, PM Yes mid 0.91) -- genuine beat streak (4-8 consecutive quarters per different sources, Zacks ESP +6.66%) but current consensus estimates split around the threshold ($1.95 Zacks vs $1.84 TipRanks), no quantified beat-probability model separates my estimate from PM's 0.91; no confident edge, skipped. CRCL (GAAP EPS threshold $0.16, PM Yes mid 0.845) -- all consensus numbers found ($0.165-$0.19) were non-GAAP; Circle is a recent IPO likely carrying material stock-based-comp drag on GAAP EPS, so applying a non-GAAP consensus to a GAAP threshold would be a methodology error, not an edge; no GAAP-specific estimate found, skipped (same conclusion as prior cycles, still no quantified model). No qualifying edge found; open-position monitor and settle still ran (d2dd24206542 live bid/ask 0.21/0.22, mid 0.215, entry 0.92, adverse -0.705, still past end date; resolve.py 0/17 settled, unchanged). Set next_full_cycle_after to 07:16Z (3h, pacing cap) -- no candidate researched this cycle has a sooner event boundary, and min_full_cycles_per_day=4 is already far exceeded in the last 24h so no urgency to force another sooner.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
